description: Manage directory users and groups, and read Microsoft 365 licenses, domains, roles and audit logs.

microsoft_365_admin_new_directory_audit_.description: Runs for each new directory audit in Microsoft 365 Admin. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, displayName

microsoft_365_admin_new_directory_user_t.description: Runs for each new directory user in Microsoft 365 Admin. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, displayName

microsoft_365_admin_new_group_trigger.description: Runs for each new group in Microsoft 365 Admin. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

microsoft_365_admin_new_or_updated_direc.description: Runs for each directory user added or changed in Microsoft 365 Admin. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, displayName
